author: Steve Peha, with Sam Illingworth
basis: Proposed classroom exercise with adult first-person demonstration
reported_outcomes: Peha reports personal reflection after a fictional-character prompt; no results from students using this exact classroom protocol.
proposed_outcomes: Use fiction to prompt independent reflective writing before group discussion.
limits: A generated character voice is an interpretation, not the original work or the author’s intention.
Private reflections need not be disclosed to the tool or classmates.
Five minutes of writing does not establish long-term inquiry or learning gains.
review_note: Retain the order: character prompt, independent student writing, then discussion. Do not imply the AI classroom routine itself has field evaluation.
coverage: Close-read all 184 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
